_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Zûc di Surround su une gracie {width}x{height}.
Tu sês zûc {player_id}. Moviments valids: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' o w/s/a/d.
Obietîf: supravivî a ducj. Lis tracis a son letalis; i impats cu la pareti a ucin; i scontrs frontâi a ucin ducj dôs.

game_action.invalid_death: Il zuiadôr {player_id} al è muart par vie di une mosse no valide.

outcome.survived_win: Il zuiadôr {player_id} al è sorevivût; ducj chei altris a son colâts.
outcome.all_crashed: Ducj i zuiadôrs a son colâts in maniere simultanie.
outcome.outlived: Il zuiadôr al è rivât a vivi plui di ducj i altris.
outcome.turn_limit: Al è rivât il limit di volte: vinç chel che al à sorevivude plui a lunc.
